The worker resolved every module type to the plugged catalog entry (the ET 200SP F-I/O items have none of their own). Passed: 77 F-parameters over 7 module types, including Failsafe_FDestinationAddress on each. Refused: Failsafe_ManualAssignmentFIODBNumber on every module and Failsafe_DisableDarkTestMaxSIL2_CAT3_PLd on the ET 200SP F-DQ (never-written classes, UnsupportedAttribute at prepare), Failsafe_SuppliedChannels_0..3 of the ET 200MP F-DI (writing one changes the unwritten Failsafe_ShortCircuitTest of its channel pair; V21 also refuses some combinations with 'set_Failsafe_... is not supported').
limitations: One candidate value per F-parameter, written in batches: a row means that batch wrote, compiled, preserved and restored it, not that every value or every single write is valid. Dependent access modes are recorded, not chased (Failsafe_ManualAssignmentFMonitoringtime makes Failsafe_FMonitoringtime writable; a disabled short-circuit test makes its timing parameters read-only).
The deny rule refuses any name containing SIL, so Failsafe_DisableDarkTestMaxSIL2_CAT3_PLd stays unwritable by design.
No safety login, password, acceptance or download; the scratch user's fail-safe access exists in the owned scratch only.
